title: Faith to Shock the World with Chris Zehner
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about the supernatural power of God's presence in The River Church's community. Hear the incredible story of how Pastor Chris's faith was sparked by a massive offering and learn how you can tap into that same kind of miraculous provision. Get ready to be encouraged and challenged to believe for the impossible in your own life as Pastor Chris shares his vision for the future of The River Church.
